definitionZh: 内装-内装-内装大小 CSS 逻辑属性定义了一个元素的内装大小,当该元素受大小限制时,浏览器可以用于布局.
sourceDefinition: The contain-intrinsic-inline-size CSS logical property defines the inline-size of an element that a browser can use for layout when the element is subject to size containment.
